title: 05. Now I Love My Teacher
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: One weekend morning, Bori was walking with Mom and suddenly stopped. Who was that fluffy person, like a cloud? Oh! It's my teacher! Bori bounced with sparkling eyes.
Bori ran over and snuggled into Teacher Sheep's arms. Mom, my teacher is the best! Teacher Sheep sings so well and gives the softest hugs. Teacher Sheep laughed and gently patted Bori's back.
But Bori hadn't always felt that way. On the first day in the Rainbow Class, Teacher Sheep had seemed so big and unfamiliar. Bori's cheeks turned red, and even looking at the teacher felt hard.
When Teacher Sheep asked, Bori, shall we play together? Bori only shook their head. Alone in a corner, Bori fiddled with blocks. I want to go home, Bori thought.
Then something happened. As Bori stood up, an elbow bumped the block castle. Crash! The carefully built castle fell down. Beside it, Hori cried out in surprise. Oh no!
Bori felt scared. What do I do? The teacher will be angry! Tears filled Bori's eyes, and those little shoulders trembled. Bori covered their face with both hands.
But Teacher Sheep wasn't angry. The teacher knelt down, met Bori's eyes, and gently stroked Bori's back. It's okay, Bori. You feel upset because the castle fell down. Those words helped Bori relax.
Teacher Sheep picked up the fallen blocks one by one. Shall we build it again? Hori can help, too! Together, the three of them built an even better castle. Bori began to smile.
From that day on, Teacher Sheep wasn't scary anymore. Bori knew it was okay to make mistakes. Every morning, Bori ran over first. Good morning, Teacher! The hugs felt so soft and warm.

Now they were back on the walking path that morning. Bori held Teacher Sheep's hand and looked up at Mom. That's why I love my teacher so much! Teacher Sheep smiled and stroked Bori's head. Warm feelings grow little by little.
